status: FROZEN before any 2023-2024 block was simulated

design_decisions.rev_kappa = 1.0: theory-neutral gate: trade iff expected edge exceeds round-trip cost. kappa = 2.0 was considered (every trade expected-positive under the evaluator's 2x stress) and rejected on the calibration window because it fired only 0.06 pairs/day. Gated trades realised ~3x their predicted edge there, so kappa = 1 already clears 2x costs in realised terms.
design_decisions.carry_gross = 1.2: risk budget of roughly 5% annual volatility for a market-neutral book; leaves headroom under the 20% single-name limit when a 10% overlay leg stacks on a carry position (max 0.075 + 0.10 = 0.175). Not optimised.
design_decisions.rev_leg = 0.10: round figure keeping the stacked single-name weight below 0.19. Not optimised.
design_decisions.carry_band = 0.25: proportional-cost no-trade region; negligible effect on the calibration window (turnover 29.1 -> 28.0) but costless.
design_decisions.rev_recalibrate = 21, rev_min_sessions =: monthly expanding-window refit; set a priori.

expectations_stated_in_advance: The combined strategy has positive net return in at least 2 of 3 test blocks.
The overlay adds return over carry-only in at least 2 of 3 test blocks.
constraint_adjustment_days = 0 in every block (the book never trips engine limits).
Net return stays positive at 1.5x cost stress in at least 2 of 3 blocks.
decision_rule: The config above is final whatever the test blocks show. It may change only to fix a demonstrable bug, and any such change is disclosed with before/after results.
validation_policy: public validation is opened once, after this walk-forward and the sensitivity analysis are complete.
